<!-- theorem-1: body_md -->
There exists a unitary, strongly rational vertex operator algebra $U$
of central charge $8$, realized as a conformal subalgebra
\[
U\subset V_{E_6\oplus A_2}\subset V_{E_8},
\]
together with a $\mathbb C$-linear ribbon equivalence
\[
\operatorname{Rep}(U)\simeq Z(\mathcal H_3),
\]
where $\mathcal H_3$ is the Haagerup fusion category. The weight-one Lie
algebra of $U$ is $\mathfrak{sl}_2\oplus\mathfrak{sl}_2$, with affine
levels $1$ and $39$.
<!-- end theorem-1 -->
